podcast.title: Music Catalog Acquisition Firm (mid-2010s)
podcast.body: One of a group of well-financed companies that have been actively buying up artists' music publishing rights since the mid-2010s, recognizing music as a valuable long-term investment. "There are companies like Primary Wave, Round Hill, Concord, and Hypnosis. They're all doing the same thing."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Song Catalog Acquisition Company
podcast.body: Hypnosis is identified as one of about a dozen companies actively involved in the business of acquiring song catalogs from artists. These companies aim to buy the publishing rights to songs, believing they can generate consistent returns through royalties over decades.

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Concept of Selling Out: Part 2
